items.text: Record results for baseline iOS × new bridge, new iOS × baseline bridge and new iOS × new bridge. Each pair actually exercises Hello, Resume, ListTasks, approvals and queue behavior with its negotiated capabilities. Independent component results may be reused when the recorded revisions match.

Swift and TypeScript both decode the same shared binary fixtures. scripts/check-fixtures-same 61b5416 reports identical bytes, with protocol field numbers, capability strings, close codes and event order covered by behavior tests.

On the integrated revisions, run scripts/check-layers, scripts/check-layers-test, scripts/swift-test --package-path ios/DSHKit, scripts/pnpm-test, scripts/check-release-clean and scripts/check-docs. Verify the paired-device round trip and distinguish any baseline failure from a new regression.
